bourns-rlb.title: Bourns RLB Series Radial Lead Inductors datasheet
bourns-rlb.notes: The product dimensions per series (diameter, height, lead spacing); the electrical specification tables of RLB0608, RLB0812, RLB1014, RLB0712, RLB0912, RLB0914 and RLB1314: inductance and tolerance, Q, test frequency, SRF minimum, RDC maximum, rated current (and Irms, Isat where given).

template.name: ${mpn}
template.description: Bourns ${mpn}, a ${l_txt} ${l_unit} +/-${tol} % radial lead inductor of the ${series} series (ferrite drum core, ${dia} mm by ${ht} mm, ${pitch} mm lead spacing): DC resistance ${rdc} ohm maximum, rated current ${i} A${isat_note}, self-resonance above ${srf} MHz, Q ${q}. The model: the inductance with its maximum DC resistance and a parallel capacitance setting resonance at the minimum SRF.

electrical.claims: The nominal inductance with the datasheet's maximum DC resistance in series and a parallel capacitance placing self-resonance at the minimum SRF; fixtures for the DC drop at the rated current and the L/R time constant.
omissions: saturation: the inductance does not fall with current${isat_note}
core losses and the Q's frequency dependence (Q ${q} at the test frequency)
the inductance tolerance (+/-${tol} %): every part is nominal
heating at the rated current (the rating is a 20 to 40 C rise) and the DC resistance's copper tempco
the winding's distributed capacitance beyond one lumped capacitor; the SRF is a minimum, real parts resonate above it

fr.description: Bourns ${mpn}, une inductance radiale de ${l_txt} ${l_unit} +/-${tol} % de la série ${series} (noyau ferrite à tambour, ${dia_fr} mm sur ${ht_fr} mm, pas de ${pitch_fr} mm) : résistance continue de ${rdc_fr} ohm au maximum, courant nominal de ${i_fr} A${isat_note_fr}, auto-résonance au-delà de ${srf_fr} MHz, Q de ${q}. Le modèle : l'inductance avec sa résistance continue maximale et une capacité parallèle plaçant la résonance au SRF minimal.

electrical.claims: L'inductance nominale avec la résistance continue maximale de la fiche technique en série et une capacité parallèle plaçant l'auto-résonance au SRF minimal ; cas de test pour la chute continue au courant nominal et la constante de temps L/R.
omissions: la saturation : l'inductance ne baisse pas avec le courant${isat_note_fr}
les pertes du noyau et la dépendance du Q à la fréquence (Q de ${q} à la fréquence de test)
la tolérance d'inductance (+/-${tol} %) : chaque exemplaire est nominal
l'échauffement au courant nominal (le courant nominal correspond à une élévation de 20 à 40 °C) et le coefficient de température du cuivre
la capacité répartie du bobinage au-delà d'un condensateur unique ; le SRF est un minimum, les composants réels résonnent au-dessus

dc_resistance.name: dc_resistance
dc_resistance.description: The rated ${i} A ramped through the inductor over 100 us, a 1000 times larger resistor across it to damp the winding's resonance: the drop is the ${rdc} ohm maximum DC resistance times the current

time_constant.name: time_constant
time_constant.description: A 1 V step into the inductor through ${rs} ohm: the current rises with the time constant L / R, the resistor's voltage 63 % of its final value one time constant later
